name: Gemini 4 Argon
short: Google DeepMind's 1M-output frontier model for long-horizon coding and enterprise research; DeepSWE 77.9% and Vals Index 68.9% both #1, gated launch.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: A unique massive-output window lets it generate whole documents and applications in one pass, and independent trackers currently rank its agentic coding at the very top.
tradeoff: Access is the real cost: a gated launch means availability and rate limits — not the price card — decide whether you can rely on it.
